entities.summary: Kim M. Cobb is an American climate scientist, professor of Environment and Society and of Earth, Environmental and Planetary Sciences at Brown University, and director of the Institute at Brown for Environment and Society. Cobb was previously a professor in the School of Earth and Atmospheric Sciences at the Georgia Institute of Technology. She is particularly interested in oceanography, geochemistry and paleoclimate modeling.
